review_evidence: Parsed the 471 listed paths from the brief and compared each with stat on reservoir-sources/Vilin97__lean-pool: 0 missing files and 0 byte-size mismatches.

Case-insensitive grep for theorem|lemma|def |structure|class|instance|inductive|abbrev|example|axiom|elab|noncomputable returned no match for 14 files. Because module names such as Codex.MainTheorem defeat this keyword grep, I also ran a scan that strips block and line comments, `module`, and import lines. It flagged 20 files with at most two residual lines, and I read all 20 in full.

Pure import-only (header, `module`, public/plain imports, docstring only), read in full: FullyDynamicMatching/FD1D.lean (1 import, docstring names FD1D.V5.Palomar.optimalDynamicMatchingUpperBound), FullyDynamicMatching/FD1D/V5.lean (24 V5 submodule imports), FullyDynamicMatching/Solution.lean (1 import, docstring on the Palomar solution and upstream comparator), Odlyzko/ECanonicalDecomposition.lean (7 Mathlib imports, compatibility-path docstring), PLAcceleratedNesterovLean/MorseBott/HessianPL.lean (2 imports), PLAcceleratedNesterovLean/MorseBott/TubularProjection.lean (3 imports), Superorthogonality/LeanSuperorthogonality/Codex.lean (2 imports), Superorthogonality/Solution.lean (1 import, docstring cites Gressman-Pierce-Roos-Yung, Proc. AMS 152 (2024)). FILTER-007 makes these FD-016 navigation-import-only candidates: they are ranked after formal content, not filtered out, so all eight are retained.

Index modules outside FILTER-007's unilateral class, read in full: DirectedTopologyLean4/SplitPath.lean, PLAcceleratedNesterovLean/{Convergence,Core,MorseBott}.lean and Convergence/{Bootstrap,Coercivity,CurvAbsorb,LocalGeometry,LyapunovContraction,MotionError,StateContraction}.lean each add `@[expose] public section`. Superorthogonality/LeanSuperorthogonality.lean adds `open Superorthogonal`. All are retained.

ZFLean/Tactics.lean (1219 bytes), read in full: it registers label attributes zrel/zpfun/zfun and defines three solve_by_elim tactic macros in namespace ZFTactics. This is real tactic content, so it is retained.

Smallest files: MotionError.lean (327 bytes) and HessianPL.lean (340 bytes) are covered above. Largest files: PebblingLean/UpperBoundParameters.lean (230279 bytes) holds 184 top-level theorem/lemma declarations plus defs splitM, splitA, minPile, loss, and costMultiplier. Chudnovsky/DivisionValues.lean (162026 bytes) holds 125 theorem/lemma declarations.

Data- and certificate-named files are genuine content: BooleanMultiplication/N3Certificate.lean (abbrev F2 := ZMod 2, theorems mul_self_f2, pow_two_f2), N3TruthTable.lean (bitF2/f2Bit conversions with simp theorems), FullyDynamicMatching/FD1D/PolynomialCertificate.lean (structure DPoly with coefficient arithmetic), FD1D/V5/CompleteFormalizationAudit.lean (elab of assert_only_standard_axioms plus assert_no_sorry checks on named FD1D.V5 theorems), Wallace/ConcreteData.lean and RationalData.lean (selector, selector_strictMono, prepared, differenceBlock).

Junk-signal grep (lorem|ipsum|placeholder|dummy|hello world|foobar|asdf) hits only a proof-placeholder docstring in CompleteFormalizationAudit.lean and local `have dummy := x.prop` proof steps in Turan3/Turans3rdProof.lean. These are not junk.

TODO/FIXME/XXX hits in Chudnovsky (DivisionValues, Kummer, SingularModuli/*), DirectedTopologyLean4/SplitPath/SplitProperties, and Odlyzko/CompletedZeta/Class* are planning or missing-docstring comments on real developments. They do not bear on exclusion.

One representative file per remaining directory has real declarations: CompositionAlgebras/Composition/Classification.lean (structure CompEmb), Koethe/Disproof.lean (KotheRadical, theorem ...general_matrix.disproof), Puiseux/Algebraic.lean (isIntegral_single_one_div), PumpingCfg/ChomskyNormalForm/ContextFreeGrammarExtras.lean (Produces.input_output), Egrs75/BadPrefixRoute.lean (mem_badIndexSet_iff, badPrefix), PebblingLean/Concentration.lean (uniformProbabilityReal), ZFLean/Booleans.lean (symmDiff, mem_symmDiff), DirectedTopologyLean4/CoverLemma.lean (mid_point_Icc).

Every path resolved with the byte size the brief lists. A comment-stripping residual scan over all 471 files, a declaration-keyword scan, and full reads of every file those scans flagged found eight pure import-only modules and twelve index modules that add only `@[expose] public section` or `open`. Under FILTER-007 in its current FD-016 state, verified import-only modules stay primary-eligible and are only ranked after formal content, so none is excluded; the rest hold real definitions, theorems, certificates, and proof-closure audits. Default disposition: retain all.
